title: Batching Advisor: shadow evals and automated rollback playbook for quality safety
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Build a production-ready Batching Advisor that recommends batching and KV-prefetch configurations, validates candidate configs via a non-invasive shadow-eval harness against a curated quality suite, and can automatically apply safe changes or run a deterministic rollback playbook when regressions are detected. The advisor should surface economic impact (tokens saved / estimated $), expected latency delta, and a risk score based on quality metrics. The feature must be compatible with hosted, dedicated, and private deployments and integrate with Console rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Advisor produces deterministic recommendation payloads for a given workload input distribution and policy (latency-first, cost-first). 2) Shadow-eval harness runs candidate config in parallel without changing live routing for at least 10k requests and produces metrics comparison to baseline. 3) Quality checks: semantic-similarity >= 0.92 OR LLM-eval score >= 0.85 AND hallucination-rate delta <= 0.01 for conversational tasks; for structured output tasks require schema-validity >= 99%. 4) If any threshold fails, the automated apply is blocked and a rollback playbook triggers a canary undo and alert. 5) Console shows recommendation, estimated savings, and a one-click apply with guardrail acknowledgement. 6) End-to-end E2E tests and a synthetic smoke canary must pass before merging.
technical_design_summary: Components: 1) Recommendation engine: uses offline trace sampling + cost model to compute batching window, max batch size, and KV cache prefetch rules. 2) Shadow-eval harness: mirrors incoming requests to a forked path where candidate config is applied; responses are compared to baseline using a multi-metric comparator. 3) Comparator: runs embedding-based semantic sim, token-level diffs, schema validators, and an LLM-based evaluator that returns a quality score. 4) Safety controller: policy engine that evaluates recommendation against thresholds and decides allow/deny/require-manual-review. 5) Apply orchestrator: performs canary apply (1% routes) with automated rollback timers and diagnostic snapshots. Implementation notes: keep shadow path sampling rate configurable, persist evaluation summaries to observability DB, and expose metrics via Console and ingestion to DataDog/SI dashboards.
test_plan: - Unit tests for cost model and recommendation outputs. - Integration tests for shadow-eval harness using synthetic workloads (conversational, summarization, JSON-output). - Golden-set runs: 5k golden prompts covering common failure modes (hallucination, omission, formatting). - Run system with candidate configs for 24h on staging traffic to collect distribution statistics. - Rollout acceptance: must pass automated thresholds on staging and internal canary before any production apply.
rollout_and_rollback_playbook: Rollout: 1) Preview recommendation in Console and notify owners via Slack. 2) Start canary apply at 1% traffic for 30 minutes. 3) Shadow-eval runs in parallel; monitor quality and cost dashboards. 4) If metrics are within thresholds, increase to 10% for 2 hours, then 50% for 4 hours, then full. Rollback Playbook (automated): A) If semantic-similarity drop > 0.04 OR LLM-eval delta < -0.05 OR schema-validity drop > 0.5%, trigger immediate automated rollback. B) Orchestrator disables candidate config and reinstates baseline routing. C) Capture diagnostic snapshot (100 recent requests, inputs/outputs, KV cache metrics, latency profiles). D) Create incident ticket auto-filled with diagnostics and notify on-call and PM owner. Manual rollback steps included for private deployments with restricted apply API.
metrics_to_monitor: - Cost savings (estimated $/hour, tokens saved) - 50/95/99 latency percentiles pre/post - Semantic similarity distribution (per workload) - LLM-eval score distribution - Hallucination-rate (detector) - Schema-validation failures - Canary error rate and 5-min error spikes
comments: 2026-03-01 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to recommendation + shadow-eval; agreed to defer autoscale tweaks until later iteration. - Ava

2026-03-03 - Architecture sync: decided to use embedding cosine@512 dims for primary semantic comparator; fallback to LLM-eval for edge cases where embeddings disagree. Action: Ravi to prototype comparator. - Feedback from Lina (MLR)

2026-03-05 - Data note: captured 48h trace from staging to form initial sample distribution. Observed long tail of short requests (<=64 tokens) making batching gains modest for chat endpoints. May recommend cache-first for these flows. - Ravi

2026-03-08 - Design review with Console team: added explicit preview UI and acknowledgement checkbox to prevent accidental autos apply. - Design (Hannah) approved mockups. PRD updated: https://docs.redwood.com/confluence/batching-advisor-design#preview-ui

2026-03-10 - Engineering spike: implemented shadow mirror router and storage of paired response sets (baseline vs candidate). Early results: for summarization workload got 12% cost reduction with semantic-similarity median 0.96. Need more samples on multi-turn chat. - Ravi

2026-03-12 - Security review: no secrets required, but private deployments will require manual apply due to restricted network control. Security ack: no additional controls needed. - Jordan (Security)

2026-03-14 - QA: integrated golden prompt set (5k) and started nightly shadow-eval runs in staging. Found one config that reduced cost by 18% but dropped schema-validity for form-fill task to 97.2% (threshold 99%). Blocked automated apply and created ENG-52502 to investigate schema regression fixes. - QA
